root_idea.summary: A root centered on eating, especially the forceful or rapid taking of food by the mouth and its swallowing.
root_idea.development: The lexical family extends from gobbling and swallowing to causative and intensive ingestion, including specialized names for foods and trees associated with the root.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested form group is displayed under the normalized citation form زَقُّوم.

senses.definition: Zaqqum: the tree in Hell and the foul food associated with it, assigned to the sinners.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic designation used in references to the tree of Zaqqum and the food of the sinner; the tree and its fruit are presented as a Hell-associated food rather than as the ordinary earthly foods or trees recorded in broader Classical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To gobble or swallow food, especially quickly and hastily; by extension, to swallow something unpleasant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal noun is زَقْمٌ. The usage is also applied to eating the food called zaqqum.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a thing to eat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form II usage; the lexical statement does not specify any authority or social relation between giver and recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone swallow a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV, used transitively with a person as the recipient of the swallowed thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To swallow a morsel or other food, leisurely or simply; also, to swallow something unpleasant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal noun is تَزَقُّمٌ. The leisurely nuance is attested in one formulation, while simple swallowing is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drink milk immoderately or abundantly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage of the Form V verb, with milk as the stated object.
Used in the expression of being smitten with the plague.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A food made of dates and fresh butter; a particular food of the Arabs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional or dialectal food designation, distinct from the Quranic Hell-associated referent.
A broader Classical use of the noun for a lethal or harmful food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular small-leaved, foul-smelling, bitter tree or desert plant of Tihamah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical designation reported for an earthly plant; the descriptions include a thornless plant with a weak flower.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular tree in Jericho bearing date-like fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its stone was traditionally described as yielding an oil used medicinally.

cautions: QAC tags the three Quranic occurrences as a proper noun, while Classical sources also use زَقُّوم as a common noun for foods and several earthly trees; these meanings are kept separate.
The Quranic form is attested only as زَقُّوم in the supplied QAC data; the broader Classical entries include related verbal, food, botanical, and medical usages.
